app.name: Music Seerr
app.subtitle: Self-hosted Music & Lyrics Downloader for Jellyfin

common.lyrics_saved_to_jellyfin: Synchronized lyrics were downloaded and saved to Jellyfin.

jellyfin.no_tracks: No tracks found in the Jellyfin library.
jellyfin.error_loading_library: Couldn't load tracks. Check the Jellyfin connection in Settings.
jellyfin.csv_modal_desc: Pair an exported CSV playlist file to verify availability in your library and download missing songs.
jellyfin.csv_owner_help: As administrator, choose the account that owns this playlist. Jellyfin will verify it can access the playlist.

settings.overview: Manage your library, Jellyfin connection, account, and language.
settings.language_section_desc: Select the application language. All text is connected to our Crowdin localization project.
settings.crowdin_info: Translations are synchronized with Crowdin. To add new languages or refine translations, join the project on Crowdin.
settings.music_dir_desc: Path where Music Seerr will save downloaded audio files and look for .lrc synchronized lyric files.
settings.jellyfin_detected_paths_desc: Jellyfin has no media upload API. It scans audio files directly from the server disk. Files downloaded by Music Seerr must go into this storage so Jellyfin can index them.
settings.jellyfin_path_not_detected: No music path detected yet. Verify your Jellyfin connection.
settings.jellyfin_path_match_note: Your local path matches the storage folder monitored by Jellyfin.
settings.jellyfin_path_diff_warning: Important: Jellyfin reads music from {path}. Because Jellyfin cannot receive files via API, this folder must point to the same physical storage (e.g. through a Docker volume mapping or an SMB/NFS network share).
settings.docker_note_body: When running in Docker, make sure this path matches the volume mount defined in docker-compose.yml (e.g. ./music:/music).
settings.jellyfin_section_desc: Connect your Jellyfin server for instant library scanning, playlist selection, and audio playback.
settings.jellyfin_api_key_help: Can be generated in: Jellyfin Dashboard > Advanced > API Keys.
settings.users_section_desc: Manage the active Jellyfin session or switch accounts.
settings.import_desc: Pick a folder on the server or upload files from this device. Music Seerr identifies each track and moves it into the library as Artist / Album (Year) / Artist - Album - NN - Title.
settings.import_folder_audio: {count} audio files directly in this folder (subfolders are included)
settings.import_nothing: No audio files found in this folder.
settings.import_done: Imported {count} tracks. Jellyfin is refreshing the library.
settings.import_error_generic: The import could not be completed.
settings.import_error_busy: Another import is already running. Try again when it finishes.
settings.import_error_folder_not_allowed: This folder is outside the music library and the import folder.
settings.import_error_no_audio: No supported audio files were selected.
settings.import_error_unsupported_file: A file type is not supported.
settings.import_error_file_too_large: A file is larger than 200 MB.
settings.import_error_too_many_files: Too many files in one upload (maximum 5000).
settings.import_error_upload_not_found: The upload expired. Select the files again.
settings.import_error_job_not_found: This import expired. Start it again.
settings.import_error_job_not_ready: This import is not ready yet.
settings.import_error_apply_failed: Moving the tracks failed. Check the folder permissions.
settings.import_duplicates_question: {count} tracks are already in the library. What should happen to the extra copies?
settings.import_duplicates_keep_upload: Do not import them (they are discarded with the upload)
settings.import_duplicates_delete: Delete them and keep only the best quality (for example FLAC instead of MP3), moved into the right folder
settings.import_done_deleted: Imported {count} tracks and deleted {deleted} duplicates. Jellyfin is refreshing the library.

auth.login_subtitle: Authenticate with your Jellyfin credentials to access Music Seerr.
auth.error_connection: Cannot reach Jellyfin server. Please verify settings.
auth.connection_detail_dns: The address {url} cannot be resolved from the Music Seerr server.
auth.connection_detail_different_server: A different Jellyfin server answers at {url}.
auth.connection_hint: Search the usual addresses automatically or enter the address of your Jellyfin server. Only the same Jellyfin server can be reconnected from here.
auth.connection_fixed: Connected to {name} at {url}. You can sign in now.
auth.connection_error_not_found: Jellyfin was not found at the usual addresses. Enter its address manually.
auth.connection_error_server_mismatch: That address belongs to a different Jellyfin server.
auth.connection_error_invalid_url: Enter a valid http:// or https:// address.
auth.connection_error_identity_unknown: The server identity is not known yet, so only the automatic search is available.
auth.connection_error_generic: Could not update the Jellyfin connection.

setup.wizard_subtitle: Complete these quick steps to connect Jellyfin and configure your music library.
setup.server_desc: Enter your Jellyfin server address and API key to establish connection.
setup.storage_desc: Set the folder where downloaded music files and lyrics will be saved.
setup.user_desc: Sign in with your Jellyfin username and password to verify user access.
setup.finish_desc: Review your configuration and start using Music Seerr.
setup.server_error: Failed to connect to Jellyfin server.
setup.server_fields_required: Enter the Jellyfin server URL and API key.
setup.storage_path_required: Enter the music storage directory to continue.
setup.user_skipped: You will continue as a guest.

history.page_description: Track downloads and recent listening in one place.
history.downloads_empty: No downloads have been recorded for this account yet.
history.plays_empty: No listening activity has been recorded for this account yet.

users.admin_controls_description: Choose whether to show controls for viewing other users’ activity and playlists.
users.show_admin_controls: Show cross-user controls in the interface
